wods.description: Two mile-long runs bookending a middle 800m run, broken up by two sets of 21 heavy clean and jerks — a running-heavy chipper with the barbell work sandwiched in the middle.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/abbate (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Adambrown

origin.summary: Honors Navy Chief Special Warfare Operator Adam Brown, 36, a SEAL killed in Afghanistan on March 17, 2010. Adam's story — documented in the book 'Fearless' — of overcoming addiction to become a decorated SEAL made this two-round heavy chipper one of the most retold Hero tributes.

wods.description: Two rounds of a seven-movement, 24-rep circuit — deadlift, box jump, wall-ball, bench press, box jump, wall-ball, and clean — a broad full-body strength-and-conditioning sweep repeated twice.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/adambrown (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Adrian
wods.description: Seven rounds of an ascending four-movement combo — 3 forward rolls, 5 wall climbs, 7 toes-to-bar, and 9 box jumps — repeated as a fixed circuit rather than building further each round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/adrian (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Alexander
wods.description: Five rounds pairing a high-rep, moderate-load back squat with a lower-rep, heavier power clean.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/alexander (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Andy
wods.description: A mirrored chipper — thrusters, box jumps, and deadlifts building in volume toward a 1.5-mile run at the midpoint, then unwinding back through the same movements in reverse.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/andy (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09; official Rx includes a 20 lb (men) / 14 lb (women) weight vest

wods.name: Arnie
wods.description: A single-kettlebell chipper of Turkish get-ups, overhead squats, and swings, alternating arms across the get-up and squat portions, all at one fixed weight throughout.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/arnie (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Artie
wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP built on the classic pull-up, push-up, and air-squat triplet with an added second pull-up set and a thruster finisher each round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/artie (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Badger

scaling.scaled: 95/65 lb squat cleans, banded pull-ups, 600m runs. This is a long workout at any scale — expect 30+ minutes and pace round one like round three.
scaling.beginner: 3 rounds: 15 light hang power cleans, 15 ring rows, 400m run. Badger's structure at a survivable dose.

origin.summary: Honors Navy Chief Petty Officer Mark Carter, 27, of Fallbrook, California, a SEAL killed in Iraq on December 11, 2007. Three rounds of squat cleans, pull-ups, and 800m runs — among the most feared of the early Heroes for its combination of load, volume, and distance.

wods.description: Three rounds of 30 squat cleans, 30 pull-ups, and an 800m run — a high-volume triplet with the run as a substantial aerobic buffer between rounds.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Barraza
wods.description: An 18-minute AMRAP of a 200m run, 9 heavy deadlifts, and 6 burpee bar muscle-ups — pairing a demanding gymnastics movement with heavy pulling.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/barraza (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bell
wods.description: Three rounds of a descending-rep barbell-and-gymnastics triplet — 21 deadlifts, 15 pull-ups, and 9 front squats — at the same barbell weight for both lifts.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bell (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bert
wods.description: A mirrored bodyweight pyramid of burpees, push-ups, walking lunges, and air squats, with a 400m run breaking up every movement on the way out and back.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bert (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Big Sexy
wods.description: Five rounds of a six-movement descending-rep circuit — heavy deadlifts and burpees, then cleans and chest-to-bar pull-ups, then thrusters and muscle-ups — getting more technical and lower-rep as it goes.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/big-sexy (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Blake
wods.description: Four rounds of overhead plate lunges, box jumps, wall-ball shots, and handstand push-ups — a lower-body-heavy circuit that finishes each round with strict gymnastics.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/blake (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bowen
wods.description: Three rounds of an 800m run followed by heavy deadlifts, burpee pull-ups, single-arm kettlebell thrusters, and box jumps — a running-anchored circuit with a long, varied tail.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bowen (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bradshaw
wods.description: Ten rounds of a short combo — 3 handstand push-ups, 6 deadlifts, 12 pull-ups, and 24 double-unders — repeated as a fixed circuit rather than building further.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bradshaw (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Brehm
wods.description: A single-round chipper of rope climbs, heavy back squats, handstand push-ups, and a rowing calorie finisher.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/brehm (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Brian
wods.description: Three rounds pairing rope climbs with a substantial back squat set — a simple but demanding gymnastics-and-strength couplet.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/brian (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bruck
wods.description: Four rounds of a 400m run followed by 24 back squats and 24 jerks — a running-anchored barbell couplet at fairly high rep counts for both lifts.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bruck (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bulger
wods.description: Ten rounds of a short 150m run, 7 chest-to-bar pull-ups, 7 front squats, and 7 handstand push-ups — the same small combo repeated at a high round count.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bulger (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Bull
wods.description: Two rounds of 200 double-unders, 50 overhead squats, 50 pull-ups, and a mile run — a high-volume, mixed-modal round repeated twice.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/bull (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Buriak
wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP of squat cleans, bar-facing burpees, pull-ups, and a 200m run — a four-movement circuit built for sustained pacing rather than a short sprint.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/buriak (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Cameron
wods.description: A ten-movement chipper alternating higher-rep bodyweight work with lower-rep gymnastics skills, finishing on rope climbs.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/cameron (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Capoot
wods.description: A descending push-up ladder (100 down to 25) paired with an ascending run distance after each set — the reps get easier as the runs get longer.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/capoot (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Chad1000x

origin.summary: Honors Navy SEAL Chad Wilkinson, who died by suicide on October 29, 2018, after multiple deployments and traumatic brain injuries. One thousand box step-ups with a 45-lb ruck, created by his wife Sara to raise awareness of veteran suicide — completed by thousands each Veterans Day as the CHAD1000X event.

wods.description: 1,000 weighted box step-ups performed wearing a ruck — a single-movement volume test with no other movements involved.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/chad1000x (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Clovis

movements.notes: partition the run and burpee pull-ups as needed

wods.description: A 10-mile run combined with 150 burpee pull-ups, partitioned however the athlete chooses — an endurance-first chipper with a large gymnastics finisher.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/clovis (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Coe

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant Keith Adam Coe, 30, killed in Khalis, Iraq, on April 27, 2010, by an explosive device. Ten rounds of thrusters and ring push-ups — pressing volume stacked past what feels reasonable, on purpose.

wods.description: Ten rounds of 10 thrusters and 10 ring push-ups — a barbell-and-gymnastics couplet repeated at high round count.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/coe (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Coffey
wods.description: A descending back squat and bench press ladder (50-35-20) with an 800m run before each set, finishing with a single muscle-up after the last run.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/coffey (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Collin
wods.description: Six rounds of a sandbag carry followed by push press, box jumps, and sumo deadlift high pulls — an odd-object carry leading into a barbell-and-jump circuit.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/collin (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Crain
wods.description: Two rounds of a seven-movement circuit — push-ups, deadlifts, box jumps, clean and jerks, burpees, wall-ball shots, and pull-ups — with a short sprint after every single movement.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/crain (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Dae Han
wods.description: Three rounds of an 800m run carrying an empty barbell, followed by rope climbs and heavy thrusters.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/dae-han (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Daniel Ray
wods.description: Five rounds of an eight-movement double-kettlebell circuit with reps climbing from 8 up to 30 across the round, closing with a 400m run each time.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/daniel-ray (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09; official Rx adds an optional load: 'If you have a weight vest or body armor, wear it.'

wods.name: Daniel

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant First Class Daniel Crabtree of the Ohio National Guard's Special Forces, killed in Al Kut, Iraq, on June 8, 2006. A symmetric chipper — pull-ups and sprints bracketing a hundred thrusters — posted among the earliest Hero workouts.

wods.description: A symmetric chipper bookended by 50 pull-ups, with a longer middle run and two sets of 21 thrusters framing it.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Danny

origin.summary: Honors Oakland Police Sergeant Daniel Sakai, 35, killed in the line of duty on March 21, 2009, alongside three fellow officers. A 20-minute AMRAP of box jumps, push presses, and pull-ups — Fight Gone Bad's engine in Hero clothing.

wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP of box jumps, push press, and pull-ups — a straightforward three-movement circuit built for sustained pacing.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/danny (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Del
wods.description: A symmetric chipper of burpees, weighted pull-ups, handstand push-ups, and chest-to-bar pull-ups, with a medicine-ball-carry run separating every movement.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/del (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Desforges
wods.description: Five rounds of a four-movement circuit, alternating a heavy lift with a higher-rep bodyweight movement each time.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/desforges (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: DG
wods.description: A 10-minute AMRAP of toes-to-bar, dumbbell thrusters, and dumbbell walking lunges — a short, dumbbell-centered triplet.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/dg (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Dobogai
wods.description: Seven rounds pairing muscle-ups with a farmers carry — a gymnastics-and-grip couplet repeated at high round count.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/dobogai (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Donny
wods.description: A deadlift-and-burpee couplet that descends 21-15-9 and then climbs straight back up to 21 — a mirrored ladder rather than a one-way descent.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/donny (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Dork
wods.description: Six rounds of double-unders, kettlebell swings, and burpees — a jump-rope-anchored triplet at descending volume per movement.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/dork (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: DT

scaling.scaled: 115/75 lb — the round rhythm (fast singles on deadlifts, unbroken hang cleans, jerks in one or two sets) is what to preserve. Grip management is the entire workout.
scaling.beginner: 65-75/45-55 lb with 3-4 rounds, or 12-9-6 per round. Learn the hang power clean's hook grip release before adding load — DT eats grip mistakes.

origin.summary: Honors Air Force Staff Sergeant Timothy P. Davis, 28, killed on February 20, 2009, in Afghanistan when his vehicle was struck by an improvised explosive device. Five rounds of deadlifts, hang power cleans, and push jerks at 155/105 — DT has become a competition classic, a pure test of barbell cycling and grip management.

wods.description: Five rounds of a descending 12-9-6 barbell triplet — deadlift, hang power clean, and push jerk — all at the same fixed weight, so the bar never leaves the hands between movements within a round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Dunn

movements.notes: jump over the box without touching it

wods.description: A 19-minute AMRAP of muscle-ups, a short shuttle sprint, and burpee box jump-overs performed without touching the box.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/dunn (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Erin

origin.summary: Honors Canadian Army Master Corporal Erin Doyle, 32, killed in a firefight in the Panjwaii District of Afghanistan on August 11, 2008. Dumbbell split cleans and pull-ups — one of the few Heroes built on a dumbbell staple.

wods.description: Five rounds of dumbbell split cleans and pull-ups — a two-movement couplet pairing a single-dumbbell Olympic-lift variant with high-rep pull-ups.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/erin (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Falkel
wods.description: A 25-minute AMRAP of handstand push-ups, box jumps, and a single rope climb each round — a longer-format gymnastics-heavy triplet.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/falkel (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Feeks
wods.description: An ascending ladder (2 up to 16) of 100m shuttle sprints paired with dumbbell squat clean-thrusters at matching rep counts each round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/feeks (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Forrest
wods.description: Three rounds of l-pull-ups, toes-to-bar, and burpees at escalating volume, capped with an 800m run each round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/forrest (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Fournier
wods.description: A chipper of shoulder-to-overhead, burpees, and sumo deadlift high pulls, broken up by three heavy arm-over-arm sled pulls.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/fournier (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Gallant
wods.description: A descending run-and-burpee-pull-up ladder — each run is carried with a medicine ball, and both the run distance and burpee pull-up count halve at each stage.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/gallant (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Garrett

origin.summary: Honors Marine Captain Garrett 'Tubes' Lawton, 31, killed by an improvised explosive device in Herat Province, Afghanistan, on August 4, 2008. Three rounds of high-volume squats, ring handstand push-ups, and L-pull-ups — gymnastics density few Heroes match.

wods.description: Three rounds of high-rep air squats followed by ring handstand push-ups and l-pull-ups — a squat-heavy round leading into two strict gymnastics movements.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/garrett (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Gator

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant Dale 'Gator' Wayrynen, 26, killed in Afghanistan on May 29, 2007 (as posted with the original CrossFit.com tribute). Eight rounds of front squats and ring dips — a leg-and-press couplet with no run to breathe on.

wods.description: Eight rounds pairing a low-rep, heavy front squat with a high-rep ring push-up set.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/gator (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Gaza
wods.description: Five rounds of a descending-rep four-movement circuit — kettlebell swings, push-ups, pull-ups, and box jumps — each capped with a full mile run.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/gaza (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Glen

scaling.scaled: 115/75 lb clean and jerks, 3 rope climbs or 15 lay-back rope pulls, trim runs to 600m. A 40+ minute effort scaled or not — fuel and pace accordingly.
scaling.beginner: Halve everything and substitute ring rows for climbs. Long chippers teach pacing better than anything short — that's the takeaway at any scale.

origin.summary: Honors Glen Doherty, 42, a former Navy SEAL working as a security contractor, killed in Benghazi, Libya, on September 11, 2012, alongside Tyrone Woods (honored by a separate workout). A long chipper — clean and jerks, running, rope climbs, and more running — matching the scale of the story it carries.

wods.description: A chipper of 30 clean and jerks, 10 rope climbs, and 100 burpees, with a mile run separating each pair of movements.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/glen (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Griff

origin.summary: Honors Air Force Staff Sergeant Travis Griffin, 28, killed on April 3, 2008, in Baghdad by an improvised explosive device while on his second tour. Uniquely in the canon, half of Griff's running is done backward — a nod that the workout should be as unusual as the man was.

wods.description: A pure running chipper alternating 800m forward runs with 400m backward runs, repeated twice.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/griff (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Gunny
wods.description: Three weighted mile runs bookending two rounds of push-ups and sit-ups.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/gunny (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09; official Rx: wear a weight vest / body armor / loaded pack totaling 50 lb for the runs

wods.name: Hamilton
wods.description: Three rounds of a 1000m row and a 1000m run, each followed by 50 reps of push-ups or pull-ups — pairing two different monostructural pieces with bodyweight work.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/hamilton (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Hansen

origin.summary: Honors Marine Staff Sergeant Daniel Hansen, killed in Farah Province, Afghanistan, on February 14, 2009, by an improvised explosive device. Five rounds of heavy swings, burpees, and GHD sit-ups — a midline crucible.

wods.description: Five rounds of 30 kettlebell swings, 30 burpees, and 30 GHD sit-ups — a straightforward high-rep triplet.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Holleyman

scaling.scaled: 20 rounds, 155/105 lb cleans, pike push-ups. The one-heavy-rep-per-round format is rare and worth keeping — it teaches arriving at a heavy bar breathing hard.
scaling.beginner: 10-15 rounds: 5 light wall-balls, 3 elevated push-ups, 1 moderate deadlift. Same metronome, humane dose.

origin.summary: Honors Army Special Forces Sergeant First Class Aaron N. Holleyman, 27, killed in Khutayiah, Iraq, on August 30, 2004, when his vehicle struck an improvised explosive device. Thirty rounds of five wall-balls, three handstand push-ups, and one heavy power clean — a metronome of a workout.

wods.description: Thirty rounds of a small descending combo — 5 wall-ball shots, 3 handstand push-ups, and 1 power clean — a far higher round count than a typical interval WOD, testing consistency over raw output per round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Hollywood
wods.description: A chipper bookended by 2000m runs, with wall-ball shots separating a muscle-up set from a heavy power clean set in the middle.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/hollywood (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Hoover
wods.description: Eight rounds of a 400m run, burpee box jump-overs, a bike-erg calorie piece, and heavy alternating dumbbell snatches.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/hoover-hero (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Hortman
wods.description: A 45-minute AMRAP of an 800m run, 80 air squats, and 8 muscle-ups — one of the longer-format Hero WODs, built for sustained output rather than a short, intense round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/hortman (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jack
wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP of push press, kettlebell swings, and box jumps — a simple three-movement circuit at even reps throughout.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jack (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jared
wods.description: Four rounds of an 800m run followed by high-rep pull-ups and push-ups — a running-anchored bodyweight couplet.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jared (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Jason

origin.summary: Honors Navy Special Warfare Operator 1st Class Jason Dale Lewis, 30, a SEAL killed in Baghdad, Iraq, on July 6, 2007. Ascending squats against descending muscle-ups — a format that front-loads the hardest gymnastics while the athlete is freshest, then takes the legs anyway.

wods.description: A mirrored ladder pairing descending air-squat volume with ascending muscle-up volume — the squats get easier as the muscle-ups get harder.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: JBo
wods.description: A 28-minute AMRAP of overhead squats and bench press at one fixed barbell weight — a long-format couplet pairing an overhead-stability movement with horizontal pressing.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jbo (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jennifer
wods.description: A 26-minute AMRAP of pull-ups, kettlebell swings, and box jumps — a long-format triplet at ascending reps across the three movements.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jennifer (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jenny
wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP of overhead squats, back squats, and a 400m run — a light-barbell squat couplet paired with running.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jenny (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jerry
wods.description: Two mile runs bookending a 2000m row — a pure monostructural piece with no barbell or gymnastics work at all.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jerry (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Johnson
wods.description: A 20-minute AMRAP of heavy deadlifts, muscle-ups, and squat cleans — combining two demanding barbell lifts with a gymnastics skill.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/johnson (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Jorge
wods.description: A descending couplet of GHD sit-ups and squat cleans, the sit-ups dropping by 6 and the cleans by 3 each round.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/jorge (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Josh

origin.summary: Honors Army Staff Sergeant Joshua Hager, 29, killed in Ramadi, Iraq, on February 22, 2007, by an improvised explosive device. Overhead squats and pull-ups in a descending-ascending ladder — one of the shorter Heroes, and no gentler for it.

wods.description: A descending 21-15-9 overhead squat ladder paired with double the pull-up reps at each step.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Joshie
wods.description: Three rounds of single-arm dumbbell snatches, alternating arms each round, paired with l-pull-ups.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/joshie (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: JT

scaling.scaled: Pike push-ups off a box for HSPU, banded ring dips, regular push-ups if needed. Three pressing movements means shoulders go fast — break sets before failure, from the first round.
scaling.beginner: 15-12-9 of seated dumbbell press, bench dips, and elevated push-ups. Pressing endurance builds slowly; volume across weeks beats heroics on day one.

origin.summary: Honors Petty Officer 1st Class Jeff Taylor, 30, of Little Creek, Virginia, a Navy SEAL killed in Afghanistan on June 28, 2005, when the MH-47 helicopter carrying a quick-reaction force to support Operation Red Wings was shot down. Posted in 2005, JT was the first Hero workout on CrossFit.com — three pressing movements and no legs to hide behind.

wods.description: A 21-15-9 triplet of handstand push-ups, ring dips, and push-ups — three different pressing variations at the same classic descending scheme as Fran.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08

wods.name: Justin
wods.description: A 30-20-10 triplet of back squat, bench press, and strict pull-up — three foundational strength movements at a shared descending rep scheme.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/justin (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09; official page lists no barbell load for back squat/bench press (conventionally performed at bodyweight)

wods.name: K27
wods.description: Twenty-seven rounds of a short hang power clean, burpee, and double-under combo — an unusually high round count that turns a small circuit into a long grind.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/k27 (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Kelly Brown
wods.description: Five rounds of a 440m row followed by box jumps, heavy deadlifts, and wall-ball shots.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/kelly-brown (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09

wods.name: Kevin
wods.description: Three rounds of heavy deadlifts, hanging hip touches, and a long running farmers carry.

wods.name: Lumberjack 20

wods.description: Seven rounds of a 400m run followed by 29 back squats — a running-and-squat couplet repeated at high round count.

wods.name: Murph

scaling.beginner: Half Murph: 800m runs bracketing 50 pull-ups (ring rows), 100 push-ups (elevated), 150 squats, partitioned. Build to the full distance across a season, not a morning.

origin.summary: Honors Navy Lieutenant Michael P. Murphy, 29, of Patchogue, New York, killed in Afghanistan on June 28, 2005, during Operation Red Wings, and posthumously awarded the Medal of Honor. This workout was one of Mike's favorites — he called it 'Body Armor.' Traditionally performed with a 20/14 lb vest, it has become CrossFit's Memorial Day tradition, completed by hundreds of thousands of athletes worldwide each year.

wods.description: A mile run bookending 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups, and 300 air squats, traditionally performed in a weighted vest and often partitioned into rounds of 5-10-20 — one of the most widely recognized Hero WODs.
wods.source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08; partition pull-ups/push-ups/squats as needed, per official prescription
